effects.trigger: physical contact with an organism infected with SCP-610
constraints: Known vectors seem focused on physical contact.

evidence.locator: At present the known infection vectors for SCP-610's spread seem to be focused on physical contact.

constraints: The path of mutation appears to be largely random.

evidence.locator: Normal human features start to disappear at this point under the infection and the path of mutation appears to be largely random.

effects.trigger: an infected individual roots itself in a suitable location
constraints: An infected individual ceases moving and roots itself.
Affected objects do not spread the infection as living creatures do.

evidence.locator: The fleshy growth on the victim will then begin to spread itself across all surrounding objects and consume them.

effects.trigger: nothing entering or leaving the infected areas

evidence.locator: The data returned from these observations coupled with the openly aggressive nature of the infected to attempt to spread SCP-610 has resulted in the Keter classification, however so long as nothing is allowed to enter or leave the infected areas it is considered a neutralized threat.
